steps.text: Hello, you've reached {{bank_name}}'s AI specialist. This call is recorded.
Hi Ben, how can I help you today?
Hey. I got a fifteen dollar fee for going overdrawn, but it was only a couple of bucks for a few hours. Any chance of getting that back?

steps.summary: Ben is asking for a $15 overdrawn fee to be refunded.

steps.text: Let's have a look. I've just sent a notification to your banking app. Please tap Approve when you see it, and I'll wait on the line.
Thanks Ben. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see the fifteen dollar overdrawn fee from yesterday. What happened there?
My gym membership came out before my pay hit. I topped it up as soon as I saw it.
Thanks, that helps. Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.summary: Ben was charged a $15 overdrawn fee when a gym membership payment came out before his pay. He topped the account up the same day and is asking for a refund.
args.customer_statement: My gym membership came out before my pay hit. I topped it up as soon as I saw it.

steps.text: That's lodged as {{propose_action.case_number|a refund request}}. {{propose_action.handled_by.name|One of our team}} is reviewing it, and you'll hear back {{propose_action.expected_timing|soon}}.
I can't promise the outcome, but we'll text you as soon as it's decided.

steps.summary: Refund request for the $15 overdrawn fee lodged for staff review.

steps.text: No worries, Ben. Have a good one.
